entities.name: Soul Trap
entities.description: Machines designed by Memnarch to abduct inhabitants from other planes to populate Mirrodin.

entities.name: Memnarch
entities.description: Designer of the soul traps, killed by Glissa.

entities.name: Glissa
entities.description: Killed Memnarch, destroying the soul traps; her spark powered Karn's spell.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: Returned to his plane after Memnarch's death and restored souls using Glissa's spark.

entities.name: The Vanishing
entities.description: What descendants called the return of the kidnapped inhabitants home.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: Those who study the remnants to spread phyresis.

events.summary: Memnarch abducts inhabitants from other planes for centuries using soul traps.
events.quote: The abductions went on for centuries.

events.summary: Glissa kills Memnarch and all soul traps are destroyed.
events.quote: When Glissa eventually killed Memnarch, all the existing soul traps were destroyed.

events.summary: Karn restores the dead and returns the kidnapped inhabitants to their homes in the Vanishing.
events.quote: He could restore the souls of everyone who died, using the power of Glissa's spark

events.summary: Phyrexians of the Progress Engine study soul trap remnants to spread phyresis.
events.quote: Remnants of the soul traps are studied by the Phyrexians of the Progress Engine

relations.quote: Soul Traps were machines designed by Memnarch
